name: BMO Cash Back Credit Card

apr.notes: 19.49% to 27.49% variable purchase APR. 0% intro APR for 12 months from the date of first transfer on balance transfers completed within 90 days of account opening, then 19.49% to 27.49%. Cash advance APR 30.74%.

fx_fee.notes: 3% of each transaction in U.S. dollars.

base_rate.description: Unlimited 1% cash back on all other eligible purchases.

categories.label: Streaming, cable TV and satellite services

signup_bonus.description: Double cash back on purchases in the first 12 months for applications received between September 1 and November 1, 2026.

notes: The 3% rate applies to up to $1,500 in gas, EV charging and grocery purchases each calendar quarter, then 1%. No Mastercard network package is stated on the product page, so network_tier is none.
